テキスト cha 650: Born around Shiyo 290. It has not been clearly established, but he is thought to have been of low birth, such as a farmer or a foot soldier. At first he took service with the Magawa house without success, and after that he served the Ouda house as a menial. Volunteering for posts such as castle construction steward and kitchen steward, he achieved great results, and gradually he rose to prominence in the Ouda house.\n　However, in Shiyo 309, hearing from a friend from his Magawa days of a plan to invade the Ouda house, he tours the provinces for just a month to find something of use to the Ouda house.

While touring the provinces, he is attacked by a boar deep in the mountains and knocked out, and is saved by Ginosuke Niimura, a resident of the Arata settlement. Ginosuke originally came from the West but found little welcome in the east; heading west, he too, like the foot soldier, was rescued by Arata's people. He stayed on and settled there, and put his grounding in medicine and biology to use to invent Droga. Using the Droga Ginosuke entrusted to him, the foot soldier splendidly leads the Ouda house to victory at the Battle of Taruhazama.

Having become ruler of the realm through the power of Droga, he is troubled by the question of a successor. By now the Droga has run out, so he has a man he trusts procure Arata cherries, the raw material of Droga, from the Arata settlement. But the Arata cherries will not grow in Kansai, and at the sight of the withered trees he falls ill and wastes away to his death.
